name: Haus Fernblick
beschreibung:
Boasting panoramic vistas across the wide Leutasch valley, Haus Fernblick features comfortable holiday apartments. It is a haven for cross-country skiers, hikers, and nature lovers.

Seefeld region trails, hiking routes through the Gaistal valley, and alpine huts are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Fernblick in Leutasch offers sunny tranquility and expansive views of the Wetterstein range.
